name: Five to One Menu Countdown
why_it_works: A countdown creates an open loop: viewers stay to find out what number one is, and every lower slot raises the stakes. By the time {{number_one}} appears, the viewer has watched four good options lose to it, so it feels earned instead of advertised.

hook.pattern: Announce a ranked countdown of your own lineup and tease that number one surprises people.
examples: Our five best sellers, ranked. Number one surprises everyone.
Ranking our whole lineup. Second place always stings.
Five to one: what regulars order at {{brand}}.

variables.name: item_2
variables.description: Second place item, the one people expect to win

variables.name: winner_reason
variables.description: One concrete reason it tops the list; 8 words or fewer, reads as a full sentence
variables.example: regulars order it twice a day

variables.name: offer
variables.description: Reason to come try number one; 6 words or fewer

beats.on_screen_text: Our top 5, ranked. #1 isn't what you think.
beats.voiceover: Our five best sellers, ranked. Number one surprises everyone.

visual.prompt: Five {{brand}} products lined up on a wooden counter, the end spot covered by a folded cloth, warm morning light, low angle, vertical 9:16
Hero close-up of {{item_5}} on a plain surface with a large number 5 shadow behind it, soft side light, vertical
Hero close-up of {{item_4}}, same surface and light as the previous shot, large number 4 shadow, vertical
Hero close-up of {{item_3}}, matching set, large number 3 shadow, vertical

beats.voiceover: Two is {{item_2}}. Everyone guesses this one.

visual.prompt: {{item_2}} in a slightly brighter spotlight, a hand reaching toward it then stopping, vertical 9:16
The cloth is pulled away to reveal {{number_one}} on the {{brand}} counter, steam or sparkle catching warm light, slow push-in, vertical 9:16
A regular customer's hands holding {{number_one}} at the {{brand}} table, candid, natural light, vertical

craft.technique: Descending countdown with a subverted favorite
craft.notes: Lower slots move fast (2 seconds each) so the pace accelerates toward the top. Number two must be the thing people expect to win; dethroning it is what makes number one feel like news. Spend the one motion beat on the reveal and nowhere else.

do_not: Rank something you are trying to clear out as number one
Let the lower slots run long; momentum is the whole format
Fake the ranking; base it on real sales or real regular orders
